TRAINING REPAYMENT AGREEMENT

This Training Repayment Agreement is made between Northwind Logistics Inc. ("Employer") and Dana Whitfield ("Employee").

1. Training. Employer will pay for Employee's commercial driver training, at a cost of $6,500.

2. Repayment. If Employee resigns within 24 months, Employee shall repay the Employer the full cost of the training. Employee authorizes Employer to deduct any amount owed from Employee's final wages.

3. At-Will Employment. Nothing in this Agreement changes the at-will nature of Employee's employment.
